# Marp guidelines

- If needed, you can split the slide's content into multiple slides by using the
  following principle:

  ```markdown
  # My presentation

  ## Content slide 1 (1)

  _Content of the first slide._

  ## Content slide 1 (2)

  _Content of the second slide, which is a continuation of the first slide._
  ```
